nina: Pushed a small docs PR to harmonize streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go. Aim: show (1) stateless resume, (2) checkpoint every N, (3) a minimal retry wrapper. Kept examples tiny. PTAL.
raj: on it. can you add a one-line clarifier about the token being opaque? folks keep confusing it with page numbers.
alec: Good call. Also suggest a one-liner about idempotency when replaying events after reconnect.
preview-bot: Preview available: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4721 (build 2)
lina: Quick scan 1 1 - python snippet looks fine but you used `marker` vs `resume_token` in the ts example; pick one.
nina: Ah, thanks. I changed to `resume_token` everywhere and added a short note: "resume_token (opaque server-provided marker)".
raj: For TS I prefer this compact retry helper (exponential backoff, stops after 3):
```ts
async function retry(fn){
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    try{return await fn()}
    catch(e){if(i===2)throw e;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50*(2**i)))}
  }
}
```
Wrap `client.stream(...)` call with `retry`.
alec: Go example needs to show persisting token on exit; tiny snippet like: 
```go
s, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
for s.Next(){chunk := s.Chunk(); token := chunk.ResumeToken(); /* write token to file */ }
```
That's enough.
lina: Found a broken relative link in the PR to `/guides/streaming` 1 should point to `/guides/streaming/resume`. Left a comment.
preview-bot: Preview updated: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4721 (build 4)
raj: I pushed wording edits: standardized on `resume_token`, added the opaque note, and the idempotency sentence: "Prefer idempotent ops when replaying or re-sending on reconnect."
nina: Thanks! I also shortened the TS iterator example to match the py style and added the checkpoint-every-10 example for Python: 
```py
with client.stream(conv, resume_token=tok) as st:
  for i,chunk in enumerate(st):
    process(chunk)
    if i%10==0: save(tok := chunk.resume_token)
```
raj: LGTM. lina?
lina: LGTM after fixing that one link. I pushed the fix. CI green.
